title: Present Tense: Common Irregular Verbs
summary: Conjugate the essential present-tense verbs ter, ir, fazer, poder, and querer.

sections.heading: Full present conjugation table
sections.body:
These verbs are irregular and very frequent. Learn them as complete forms because they appear in everyday sentences from the beginning.

| Subject | ter | ir | fazer | poder | querer |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| eu | **tenho** | **vou** | **faço** | **posso** | **quero** |
| você/ele/ela | **tem** | **vai** | **faz** | **pode** | **quer** |
| nós | **temos** | **vamos** | **fazemos** | **podemos** | **queremos** |
| vocês/eles/elas | **têm** | **vão** | **fazem** | **podem** | **querem** |

examples.en: She goes/is going to the market.
We make coffee in the morning.

sections.heading: Ter: possession, age, and obligation
sections.body: **Ter** means 'to have'. It is used for possession, age, and, with **que**, obligation. The accent distinguishes **tem** (singular) from **têm** (plural) in writing.

sections.heading: Ir, fazer, poder, querer in daily speech
sections.body: These verbs combine with infinitives to make useful expressions: **vou sair**, **posso ajudar**, **quero comer**. **Fazer** also appears in weather and time expressions.

examples.en: I am going to talk to her today.

examples.pt: Faz dois anos que moro aqui.
examples.en: I have lived here for two years.

sections.heading: Questions and negatives
sections.body: For questions, keep normal word order and use intonation. For negatives, place **não** before the conjugated verb.

keyPoints: Ter, ir, fazer, poder, and querer are core irregular present-tense verbs.
Você uses the same form as ele/ela; vocês uses the same form as eles/elas.
Tem and têm sound similar but are written differently in standard Portuguese.
Use ir + infinitive for the near future: vou estudar.
Use poder and querer before an infinitive without a preposition.

commonMistakes.note: Plural têm has a circumflex in writing.
Poder is followed directly by the infinitive.
